name: limn
description: Realtime collaborative whiteboard with OpenCV stroke beautification and Gemini-powered diagram synthesis.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n web,cv -c cyan,green "pnpm dev:web" "pnpm dev:vision"
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @limn/protocol test && pnpm --filter @limn/shapes test && pnpm --filter @limn/web test && pnpm test:db && pnpm test:vision
